title: 美国复古水彩文旅海报
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE premium vertical 4:5 vintage watercolor travel-collage poster. The supplied China image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION reference: emulate its warm aged ivory paper, subtle paper fibers, rich but softly muted watercolor illustration, delicate realistic ink detail, monumental antique-brown serif title, fine corner ornaments, poetic atmospheric transitions and layered foreground objects. The poster must feel like one continuous dreamlike landscape, with varied-scale landmarks connected by mist, water, foliage and softly bleeding watercolor edges. Elegant visual hierarchy, luminous atmospheric distance, refined detail throughout. Natural cream, mineral green, dusty blue-gray, ochre and pale peach palette. Keep top title clean and readable, preserve generous margins. Flat illustrated paper artwork, not a miniature diorama. No inset boxes, no architectural technical diagrams, no 3D display plinth, no watermark. Artistic geographic compression is intended, not a literal map. Text must be limited to the exact specified headings and short labels. SUBJECT: The United States of America. Entire imagery must celebrate US landscapes and culture. Exact heading at top in two modest Chinese characters "美国", followed by enormous elegant serif "AMERICA", then small widely spaced subtitle "LANDSCAPES & STORIES". Composition: upper left dramatic granite Yosemite valley cliffs with a waterfall and tall evergreen trees fading into mist; upper right a beautifully drawn Statue of Liberty with correct crown and raised torch, elevated above a softly hinted New York harbor skyline; mid-left the rust-red Golden Gate Bridge spans a hazy blue bay; mid-right layered red-orange Grand Canyon cliffs draw into the distance; lower-middle a Yellowstone-inspired valley with a small grazing American bison and a pale turquoise thermal spring, integrated gently into the panorama. Use a winding river and cloud wisps to unify the geographically separate scenes. Foreground: a small arrangement of a worn leather road-trip journal, a simple enamel coffee mug, a slice of apple pie on a ceramic plate, and a loosely folded road map without legible invented text; a modest sprig of native wildflowers. Objects stay subordinate to the landscape. Add exactly four fine handwritten labels near matching scenes: "Yosemite", "Golden Gate", "Grand Canyon", "New York". Optional tiny footer, exact text: "From coast to canyon, a journey to remember." Use restrained Art Deco-like hairline corner ornaments appropriate to the travel-poster style. Do not include Chinese temples, pandas, Chinese porcelain, red Chinese seals, the Great Wall, stereotyped Indigenous costumes, a flag collage or political imagery.
